admission.justification: Binds the public tool roster to the served set: a removed tool stays removed from roster, registration and registry together.

alternatives.option: Public roster carries 73 names ending knowledge_read/knowledge_diff/knowledge_integrity_check; registration advertises three knowledge names; the registry holds three rows.
alternatives.reason: knowledge_change and knowledge_project have no producer; advertising them would promise a write path the converted tree refuses.

alternatives.option: Keep advertising knowledge_change and knowledge_project in roster, registration and registry.
alternatives.reason: Leaves a write promise with no producer on a tree that refuses writes; remove if a write producer ever ships.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A knowledge write producer ships with a governed contract row.

consequences: Re-adding a knowledge write tool requires a producer, a contract row and a roster entry together, not one of the three.
context: MIK-R74 sheds the logical dataset: with no dataset there is no change/project surface, only read/diff/integrity-check over the derived index.
